top_signals.title: AI skeptics from Bernie Sanders to Steve Bannon urge action, as Congress, Trump idle
top_signals.summary: Lawmakers and AI regulation advocates met Tuesday in Washington at a Future of Life Institute event to urge regulatory action to rein in the expanding technology.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Kennedy Center board votes to close for renovations; judge blocks Trump name returning to building
top_signals.summary: The ruling comes four months after the same judge ordered that the Kennedy Center could not be renamed to include President Trump's name.
